name: Sanguine Wideback
description: Draw the blade with qi running from every primary meridian into the wrist for a steady hard cut.

name: Torrent Mow
description: Step back as the heavy blade recovers and reset the guard before the opponent can close.

name: Iron Machhilt
description: Brace the spine against the forearm and block a heavy overhead cut.

name: Paralyzing Brushcut
description: Hook the belly of the blade on the opponent's guard and draw it open.

name: Sanguine Lashdown
description: Feed qi from the meridians into a slash that cuts through a raised guard and the arm behind it.

name: Toxin Cutback
description: Slap the qi-hardened flat across the opponent's blade and spin it out of line.

name: Equipoise Heavytang
description: Take a blow on the spine and let it spring the blade back toward the attacker.

name: Lambasting Rivetgrip Assault
description: Pour qi from every primary meridian into one overhead drop that fells a guard and the arm behind it.

name: Shade Weightedge
description: Press forward behind chained heavy cuts that keep the opponent backing across the ground.

name: Ironweed
description: Draw the blade as the qi field pulses outward and open the exchange with one clean cut.

name: Gust Clearcut
description: Take one long low step that carries the body under the opponent's first stroke.

name: Torrent Thickbelly
description: Turn the outer wrist into an incoming cut and push it wide.

name: Hoarfrost Brushedge
description: Hold the blade steady and let the thin field around it take the force of a glancing blow.

name: Staggering Bluntspine
description: Rap the back of the blade across the opponent's wrist and shake the grip loose.

name: Granite Widetip
description: Send a pulse of field qi along the edge so the slash lands harder than its reach suggests.

name: Hoarfrost Wideback
description: Thicken the living field before the blade and turn aside a flurry of light cuts.

name: Thorn Chopedge
description: Hook the field around the opponent's weapon and pull its edge off line.

name: Nova Thickbelly
description: Let the field run a hand's breadth past the edge so the cut lands beyond the blade's true reach.

name: Brushedge Cloak
description: Spread the field behind the blade as a standing guard that holds as the edge moves forward.

name: Blaze Rivetgrip
description: Cut along the seam of a strap where armor is stitched and weakest.

name: Skinning Widetip
description: Jab the point into the gap between two armor plates at the joint.

name: Murk Heavytang
description: Roll the shoulder under a cut and glance it off the blade's flat.

name: Silt Lashdown
description: Step close inside the armored foe's swing where his long weapon cannot reach.

name: Harrowing Mow
description: Cut with qi packed into the edge to shear the rivets that hold armor plates together.

name: Granite Brushcut
description: Bring the weighted belly down on a greave to crack it and the shin beneath.

name: Glintbush
description: Drive the point down a breastplate seam with full-meridian qi and split it open to the body.

name: Mayhembush
description: Strike the rim of a helm with the spine so the ringing blow dazes the wearer.

name: Tempered Cutback
description: Draw the long blade with the arm fully extended so the cut lands at the far edge of reach.

name: Granite Clearcut
description: Sweep with the whole arm straight and keep the foe at the tip of the blade.

name: Machhilt Greave
description: Hold the long blade out like a rail in front of the body and stop a rush.

name: Hacksweep Sprint
description: Slide the rear foot forward while the blade stays at full extension.

name: Ironbush
description: Jab along a straight line from the shoulder and keep the point on the foe's centre.

name: Heavy Chopedge
description: Feel the opponent's distance through the length of the blade and judge the next cut by it.

name: Rumble Machhilt
description: Lengthen the cut with a line of qi that carries the edge a step beyond the blade.

name: Gyve Thickbelly
description: Snare the opponent's weapon at the blade's far edge and hold it away from the body.

name: Rumble Bluntspine
description: Meet an opponent who has overreached and cut into the arm that stretches past the guard.

name: Daybreak Hacksweep
description: Swing a full circle on a field of qi that cuts everything within the blade's wide reach.

name: Rumblebush
description: Drive a single line of field qi from the far edge through armor and guard along the reach.

name: Mightvine
description: Draw the blade in a cut that sets up a second cut to land in the same place.

name: Mightscrub
description: Cut from each hip in turn and keep both strokes in one smooth rhythm.

name: Whipping Bluntspine
description: Step down a sloping bank with the blade held high so the body keeps balance.

name: Thornscrub
description: Bring the free hand behind the blade to double the guard against a heavy cut.

name: Gust Weightedge
description: Parry in a curved line like a river bend and send the cut past the body.

name: Dominating Chopedge
description: Take the spine in the free hand and rap it down onto the opponent's blade.

name: Gustscrub
description: Run qi down two tracks of the arm into the edge so the cut carries twice the bite.

name: Crippling Cutback
description: Catch the opponent's wrist between the blade and the free hand and lock it fast.

name: Immovable Rivetgrip
description: Raise the blade in a rising guard that holds against a stroke aimed from above.

name: Granite Lashdown
description: Cut once and echo the same cut a breath later a hand's width to the side.

name: Mowthrash
description: Fell the guard with the first drop and the arm behind it with the second landing in the same breath.

name: Dismantling Mow
description: Sweep the blade in a wide river-bend arc that cuts every foe within reach on that side.

name: Steadfast Heavytang
description: Perch the blade high over the shoulder in a guard that sees every approach.

name: Wideback Maelstrom
description: Stoop low from the perch and draw the blade upward into the foe's guard.

name: Racing Hacksweep
description: Step along a straight line toward the opponent as a hawk falls on its prey.

name: Paralyzing Widetip
description: Rap the flat of the blade against the opponent's sword arm like a pinion beating down.

name: Fastening Hacksweep
description: Hook the curve of the blade into the opponent's guard as a talon takes hold.

name: Blaze Brushcut
description: Slash with the field flared like a wing to widen the cut past the blade.

name: Vineplating
description: Stoop beneath a cut and let the blade rise to turn it aside in one motion.

name: Iron Brushcut
description: Leap and fall on the foe with the whole body and field behind a single felling cut.

name: Weedhauberk
description: Spread the field behind the blade like a wing and hold the line against several attackers.

name: Siltscrub
description: Shuffle the feet along a ford without lifting them clear of the stones.

name: Tempered Clearcut
description: Cut along the lip of a bank at an opponent who stands on the slope below.

name: Scrubcloak
description: Slip the blade with the flow of a stroke and let the current of it pass.

name: Vinebarrage
description: Part tall reeds with a flat slash and cut the foe hidden behind them.

name: Weightedge Plating
description: Plant the feet on firm stone and take a blow without sliding back.

name: Sanguine Cutback
description: Cut in midstream with qi pooled in the wrist and sweep through the opponent's guard.

name: Toxinbush
description: Turn the blade in a tight eddy that drags the opponent's weapon off its stroke.

name: Lashdown Cuirass
description: Hook the opponent's lead leg from beneath and pull it as an undertow pulls a wader.

name: Granite Chopedge
description: Rise with the full surge of qi and bring the cut down like a flood crest breaking.

name: Silt Brushedge
description: Lay a low line of qi across the ground with the blade's tip that snares the next foe to cross it.

name: Blazevine
description: Draw the blade out along the open ground in one sweep with nothing to catch it.

name: Gustmow
description: Take a bearing on the foe and step along it without a pause.

name: Charter Weightedge
description: Hold the blade square and break the force of an attack as a stone breaks wind.

name: Unmaking Thickbelly
description: Sweep wide across open ground and cut every low guard in the stroke's path.

name: Iron Rivetgrip
description: Draw breath like a rising gale and send it through the arm into a hard slash.

name: Bushgreave
description: Hold the bearing against the opponent's feint and check the true stroke when it comes.

name: Blaze Heavytang
description: Fell the foe with a downward cut that carries the full weight of the open plateau wind.

name: Vinethrash
description: Hold the bearing and press forward behind a chain of cuts that gives the foe no room to turn.

name: Trouncing Widetip
description: Draw the blade as if swearing it to the wind and cut in one rising line.

name: Trouncing Wideback
description: Slash across the foe's line like a crosswind and give no head-on mark to meet.

name: Torrent Machhilt
description: Lean into the wind with the shoulder and step out of the way of a lunge.

name: Hoarfrost Widetip
description: Raise the sworn hand with the blade and stop a cut before it reaches the chest.

name: Chime Bluntspine
description: Knock a blow aside with a short gust of the blade across its line.

name: Iron Wideback
description: Mark the opponent's bearing from the set of the shoulders before the first stroke is thrown.

name: Rumblescrub
description: Cut with qi riding the breath so the stroke arrives faster than the arm seems to move.

name: Charter Mow
description: Press the spine down against an oncoming blade like a headwind that stops a stride.

name: Gustbush
description: Lift the blade in a rising parry that throws the cut up and off the line.

name: Mightbush
description: Bring the sworn stroke down with the weight of a rising gale to fell the guard and the arm.

name: Chopedge Greave
description: Hold the lane of the wind with sweeping cuts that keep the foes from stepping through.

name: Rivetgrip Torment
description: Cut along the rim of the ground with the whole body leaning out over the edge.

name: Thorn Weightedge
description: Brace the feet as sworn to the ground and take a heavy cut on the spine.

name: Steadfast Brushedge
description: Turn the blade to the windward side and push a thrust out onto the open air.

name: Careening Machhilt
description: Step out into open ground under the sky where no cover holds the foe.

name: Ironmow
description: Set the sworn edge into the foe's guard and bite through it with a surge of qi.

name: Fastening Mow
description: Lock the blades at a held bearing and pin the foe to a line of the cultivator's choosing.

name: Thickbelly Greave
description: Lean against the blow like a tree in a gale and spring back with the counter.

name: Transfixing Hacksweep
description: Bring the oathbound blade down in one heavy fall that breaks through the guard.

name: Aegis Bluntspine
description: Raise a standing cover of the plateau gale about the blade that turns blows from every side.
